Recommendation: Contain focus in the Library editor
Acceptance check: Open a fictional book with keyboard; cycle forward/backward through all controls; focus never enters covered content; Escape returns to the invoking book without losing shelf/search position.
Normal-size dock text meets 4.5:1 in every supported theme; active, inactive, keyboard focus and disabled states remain distinguishable. Include a real-phone sunlight check.

Recommendation: Make All Spaces a visible, comfortable navigation action
Evidence: S01, S08, S23; measured target geometry
Acceptance check: At 320 and 390px, reach an unpinned space without guessing a gesture, overlapping Capture or needing a precision tap. Verify minimum target-size geometry and actual thumb use.

Recommendation: Open the specific work item from planning views
Acceptance check: With several fictional projects and actions, each planning row opens exactly its referenced object; Back restores the same week and position; completed or missing sources get an explicit recoverable state.

Recommendation: Put Music listening results before secondary panels
Acceptance check: At 390 x 844, the initial view contains the period, meaningful listening summary and at least the first ranked results. Desktop exposes both rankings together. Empty and low-coverage histories remain understandable.

Recommendation: Make the weekly question determine mobile order
Acceptance check: On phone, the first view signals both selected work and upcoming constraints. Test 0, 2 and 8 intentions. One date-bearing focused action is recognisable as the same source in both contexts.

Recommendation: Disambiguate the two meanings of This week
Acceptance check: A fictional undated focus item has an obvious place or an explicit coverage explanation on Home. Counts and empty states describe the same scope as the heading.

Recommendation: Resolve Agenda around ownership and time horizon
Acceptance check: For each event type, the primary action reaches its owner. A week-to-upcoming path preserves near-term and later commitments. Remove Agenda only after its unique creation, meeting and browsing jobs have working homes.

Evidence: S02, S05, S11; computed field styles
Acceptance check: Computed editable field text is at least 16px on phone; focusing fields on a real iPhone does not cause unwanted zoom; the focused field and submit/cancel actions remain reachable with the keyboard open.

Recommendation: Preserve space names at narrow widths
Acceptance check: All active space names remain understandable at 320px and enlarged text, including the longest destination. No page-wide horizontal scroll or clipped navigation text.

Recommendation: Distinguish an absent income baseline from a zero budget judgment
Acceptance check: Fictional no-income-entered, genuine-zero and positive-income cases are separately understandable. Allocation rules remain the current fixed reference unless a product decision explicitly changes them.

Recommendation: State the denominator behind expense averages
Acceptance check: With one populated month in a longer selected interval, a user can identify which months the average includes. True zero-record months, unknown recording coverage and a partial current month are not presented as equivalent evidence.

Recommendation: Make Calendar coverage and freshness visible where the week relies on it
Acceptance check: Connected, disconnected, partial-source, failed-fetch and stale-result states can be distinguished without opening Account. No empty state claims the person is available.

Recommendation: Separate Library reading from comprehensive editing
Acceptance check: From a fictional book, read its takeaway or update the main reading state without traversing unrelated fields. Editing remains complete, cancellable and accessible.

Recommendation: Expose expansion state and disambiguate repeated actions
Acceptance check: Accessibility inspection identifies which list is expanded and which object each Edit/Pause/Remove affects. Keyboard activation and focus remain stable after expanding/collapsing.

With NVDA or VoiceOver, changing period announces progress and completion once, keeps focus on the chosen control, and permits navigation into the updated results. Error and empty states remain distinct.

Recommendation: Keep Music view state recoverable across navigation
Basis: Source-confirmed state model; history variants unverified
Acceptance check: Select a historical year/month, visit another PCC space and return; mode, period and expansion behavior follow an explicit documented contract. A URL with valid view parameters restores the intended view; invalid parameters have safe defaults.

Recommendation: Replace the universal card treatment with a product-specific hierarchy
Acceptance check: Compare distinctly different visual systems using the same fictional content and real tasks on phone and desktop. The preferred system improves scan order, direct action and recognition; contrast and semantic states pass in all retained themes.
